data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 288.884m. The technical provisions note shows a small gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 0.199m (gross change in estimates of prior year provisions), driven by minor adjustments to prior-year estimates; on a net basis the movement was a release due to a reduction in the reinsurers' share. Overall the movement is immaterial relative to the opening reserves and no material line-by-line prior-year deterioration was reported.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in estimates of prior year provisions

an explicit impact for claims inflation has been included within the best estimate reserves, in line with SCOR Group scenarios and Lloyd's guidelines. The overall impact across all lines of business for all underwriting years is GBP 2.7m net (2023: GBP 3.8m) on an earned basis.
We continue to monitor any potential losses arising out of the Russian invasion of Ukraine however, given information currently available, we believe such losses to the Syndicate to be immaterial.

Weather catastrophes dominated the losses, notably Hurricane Helene followed swiftly by Milton coming towards the back end of the hurricane season. Despite this, the Syndicate outperformed the catastrophe budget.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross GBP 199k). Triangle values are reported in the original table unit (thousands).
